title: An unanswered question
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Several lines of evidence constrain the gravitational behavior of dark matter. Those measurements have not yet settled the nature of the underlying physical substance.

misconception: A learner may choose: Yes: it is proven to be ordinary smoke
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Do measurements of dark matter's gravitational effects already establish exactly what it is made of?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Do measurements of dark matter's gravitational effects already establish exactly what it is made of? No: its physical nature remains unknown. Several lines of evidence constrain the gravitational behavior of dark matter. Those measurements have not yet settled the nature of the underlying physical substance.
Visual caption: Evidence, identity still open. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
